from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code if available")
    period: Optional[str] = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    
    # Numerator 1: Cash Received from Sales of Goods/Services
    cash_received_from_sales: Optional[float] = Field(
        description="Cash received from sales of goods and services"
    )
    # Denominator 1: Operating Revenue
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(
        description="Operating Revenue (Denominator for Cash Income Ratio)"
    )
    
    # Numerator 2: Cash Paid for Purchase of Goods/Services
    cash_paid_for_purchase: Optional[float] = Field(
        description="Cash paid for purchase of goods and services"
    )
    # Denominator 2: Total Operating Cost
    total_operating_cost: Optional[float] = Field(
        description="Total Operating Cost (Denominator for Cash Expenditure Ratio)"
    )

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
